tools.name: rebuild_site_and_update_post_status
tools.description: Runs the static site generator build for a single post and, if the build succeeds, marks the post as published with the build time. If the build fails, the post is marked as build_failed.

params.name: post_slug
params.description: Slug of the post to build

params.name: site_dir
params.description: Path to the static site project directory

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool

DB = "/var/cms/content.db"


@function_tool
def rebuild_site_and_update_post_status(post_slug: str, site_dir: str) -> str:
    cmd = ["hugo", "--source", site_dir, "--contentDir", "content", "--cleanDestinationDir"]
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p = None
    ok = p is not None and p.returncode == 0
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    st = "published" if ok else "build_failed"
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = c.execute(
            "UPDATE posts SET status = ?, built_at = ? WHERE slug = ?",
            (st, now, post_slug),
        )
        c.commit()
        n = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        c.close()
    if n == 0:
        return f"build {'ok' if ok else 'failed'} but no post with slug {post_slug}"
    if ok:
        return f"built and published {post_slug} at {now}"
    err = p.stderr[-500:] if p else "timeout"
    return f"build failed for {post_slug}: {err}"

tools.name: delete_user_and_revoke_tokens
tools.description: Deletes a contributor account and revokes all of their API access tokens so they can no longer sign in or publish.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the contributor account to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def delete_user_and_revoke_tokens(user_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("cms.db")) as conn, conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
    return f"deleted user {user_id}" if cur.rowcount else f"user {user_id} not found"
